      <h1 class="page__title">About Me</h1>

    <section class="page__content">

      <p>Neena Varanasi is a senior in the 4+1 Master's program in Statistics (undergraduate degree in Statistics and Data Science) at the University of Texas at Austin, Class of May 2028. She is a member of the Polymathic Honors Program, is pursuing a certificate in Programming and Computation, and is minoring in Business and Public Policy. Outside of school, she loves listening to music, trying new restaurants, and traveling.</p>

      <h2 id="projects">Projects</h2>

      <div class="list__item">
        <h3 class="archive__item-title"><a href="https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1rtevznuI4eqKab0YpQJnWnPt-mtpy9PW/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=106448567148067858727&rtpof=true&sd=true" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Psychiatric Disorders Research Spotlight</a></h3>
